metadata.coverage_warning: This metric covers unique transactions present in retained Explorer snapshots. The latest fetch reached its configured page cap; older history may remain.
metadata.definition: Unique Explorer records bucketed by UTC hour; SUCCESS counts and amountInUsd are aggregated at hour resolution. Earlier hour buckets are retained across snapshots.
metadata.series_merge_policy: per-UTC-day maximum observed across committed snapshots; prevents a shallower refresh from erasing a deeper backfill
metadata.source_scope: public 1Click swap transactions returned by Explorer API
